answers.core:
Given that something like TabContainer's behaviour of setting tab names is part of core already, I think that something that allows those names to be modified without additional script would fit in.
Also, given the minor nature of the change I feel that it would be too small to be worth a full on addon.
answers.workaround: Yes, however it would often need the creation of a new script, which would only be a `_ready` function with `set_tab_title` calls. Considering the only purpose of the script will be to set static data, I feel it being a property editable in the inspector would fit better.

title: Add a default tab titles property to TabContainer
